content:
Teacher! May I go to the bathroom?
Class is over in 5 minutes, Donna.
Can I go then?
Yes, you can, Donna.
I don't know if I can hold it.
If you can't, then go, dear.
I think I can go in a few minutes.
Thank you, Donna.
